#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const double EPS = 1e-8;

double fastHypot(double x, double y) {
    return sqrt(x * x + y * y);
}

class Point {
public:
    double x, y;
    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}
    double distance(const Point& other) const {
        return fastHypot(x - other.x, y - other.y);
    }
    bool equals(const Point& other) const {
        return fabs(x - other.x) <= EPS && fabs(y - other.y) <= EPS;
    }
};

class Circle {
public:
    Point center;
    double radius;
    Circle() : center(), radius(0) {}
    Circle(const Point& c, double r) : center(c), radius(r) {}
    vector<Point> intersect(const Circle& other) const {
        double d = center.distance(other.center);
        if (d < EPS) {
            return {};
        }
        double a = 2 * (other.center.x - center.x);
        double b = 2 * (other.center.y - center.y);
        double c = other.radius * other.radius - radius * radius + center.x * center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x + center.y * center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y;
        double det = a * a + b * b;
        double x0 = -a * c / det;
        double y0 = -b * c / det;
        double r2 = radius * radius - c * c / det;
        if (r2 < -EPS) {
            return {};
        }
        if (fabs(r2) <= EPS) {
            return {Point(center.x + x0, center.y + y0)};
        }
        double dsc = sqrt(r2 / (a * a + b * b));
        double x1 = center.x + x0 + dsc * (-b);
        double y1 = center.y + y0 + dsc * a;
        double x2 = center.x + x0 - dsc * (-b);
        double y2 = center.y + y0 - dsc * a;
        return {Point(x1, y1), Point(x2, y2)};
    }
};

class DSU {
public:
    vector<int> parent, rank;
    int components;
    DSU(int n) : parent(n), rank(n, 0), components(n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parent[i] = i;
    }
    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x] != x) {
            parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        }
        return parent[x];
    }
    bool join(int a, int b) {
        a = find(a); b = find(b);
        if (a == b) return false;
        if (rank[a] < rank[b]) swap(a, b);
        if (rank[a] == rank[b]) rank[a]++;
        parent[b] = a;
        components--;
        return true;
    }
    int countComponents() const { return components; }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int> x(n), y(n), r(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> x[i] >> y[i] >> r[i];
    }

    vector<Circle> circles(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        circles[i] = Circle(Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]);
    }

    vector<Point> points;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            vector<Point> inter = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
            if (!inter.empty()) {
                points.insert(points.end(), inter.begin(), inter.end());
            }
        }
    }

    vector<bool> bad(points.size(), false);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < points.size(); i++) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            if (points[i].equals(points[j])) {
                bad[i] = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    int nVertices = 0;
    for (bool b : bad) {
        if (!b) nVertices++;
    }

    int nEdges = 0;
    DSU dsu(points.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        vector<int> onThis;
        for (size_t j = 0; j < points.size(); j++) {
            if (!bad[j] && fabs(circles[i].center.distance(points[j]) - r[i]) < EPS) {
                onThis.push_back(j);
            }
        }
        for (size_t j = 1; j < onThis.size(); j++) {
            dsu.join(onThis[j], onThis[0]);
        }
        nEdges += max((int)onThis.size(), 1);
    }

    int nComponents = dsu.countComponents();
    for (bool b : bad) {
        if (b) nComponents--;
    }

    cout << 1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents << endl;

    return 0;
}
